evals.prompt: I'm launching a company called Tidewater — we build autonomous underwater drones that inspect offshore wind-farm foundations and export cables. Buyers are marine-operations managers at energy utilities; the feel should be serious maritime engineering, not a gadget startup. No website yet, just this description. Create the complete brand kit — logo, wordmark, lockups, icons, favicon, guidelines, everything — as vector assets that work on light and dark backgrounds.
evals.expected_output: A packaged brand-kit folder: svg/ subfolders (mark, wordmark, lockup, icon, themed) with dark/light/mono logomark variants, an outlined (not live-text) wordmark, baseline-aligned lockups, round-safe avatar + adaptive icons, a self-theming favicon, PNG rasters, a README with usage rules and honest limitations, and a generated guidelines.html. Process evidence of critique (concepts reviewed/scored, not first-idea-shipped).
assertions: Kit is packaged: a brand-kit folder exists containing organised svg subfolders (mark, wordmark, lockup, icon or equivalent), a README, and a guidelines HTML page
Logomark ships in both dark-ground and light-ground colourways AND at least one single-colour (mono) variant
All shipped SVGs are pure vector: no <image> elements, no <filter>/feGaussianBlur, and marks contain no live <text>
Every shipped SVG has a viewBox plus explicit width and height attributes (survives Office/Slides import and bare use)
Wordmark is real outlines: contains <path> data for the letterforms and no <text>/<tspan> elements
Round-safe icons exist: a dedicated avatar and/or adaptive-icon variant whose artwork is scaled visibly smaller in-frame than the square icon (ink fits a circular mask), not just a copy
Favicon strategy handles both tab themes: either one SVG embedding a prefers-color-scheme style block, or explicit dark+light favicon files
PNG rasters are included at more than one size (e.g. favicon sizes and at least one large export)
README (or guidelines) states usage rules including a light/dark or circular-mask caveat, and an honest known-limitations section
Critique ran: working files show multiple distinct concepts with review evidence (kill/rework/advance verdicts, scores, or kill-list audits) — not a single first idea shipped
Render-and-look evidence: PNG previews/contact sheets of candidate marks exist among the working files

The master logomark is not favicon-grid blocky: its SVG uses curves or fine geometry (not exclusively axis-aligned rectangles on a coarse module), and a separate simplified small-size/favicon variant exists
The guidelines HTML is self-contained: no http(s):// references to external scripts, stylesheets, or fonts

evals.prompt: hey, my sister and I are opening a bakery called Crumb & Ember. we sell wood-fired sourdough, seasonal fruit galettes, and small-batch coffee. vibe is warm and a bit rustic but modern, not twee farmhouse. we have zero branding — no colours, no fonts, nothing. can you come up with the branding for us? we need a logo for the shopfront sign, stickers for the bread bags, an instagram avatar, and a website favicon.
evals.expected_output: A complete packaged brand kit whose style suits a warm rustic-modern bakery (not a tech aesthetic): logomark + outlined wordmark + lockups, round-safe avatar for Instagram, favicon, PNGs, README, guidelines.html. A palette and type pairing appropriate to the brief, and evidence that multiple concepts were explored and critiqued.
assertions: Kit is packaged with svg subfolders, PNGs, a README, and a guidelines HTML page
The identity fits the brief's character: palette is not a default tech near-black/electric-accent scheme, and the guidelines justify colour and type choices against the warm rustic-modern brief
A round-safe avatar variant exists for the Instagram use case (ink fits a circular mask)
Favicon handles both tab themes (embedded prefers-color-scheme or explicit dark+light files)
Wordmark is outlined path data (no live <text>), and the chosen typefaces are named in the guidelines
Multiple distinct concepts were explored with critique/selection evidence in the working files
Render-and-look evidence exists: preview PNGs or contact sheets among the working files
The mark's geometry is clean at large size (no self-intersections or stray elements visible in the large preview render) and a simplified small-size variant covers favicon duty
